headline: US Judge Rules Against Novo Nordisk in Eli Lilly Weight-Loss Ad Dispute
summary: A US judge has refused to block advertisements for Eli Lilly's weight-loss drug, ruling against a legal challenge brought by rival drugmaker Novo Nordisk.
why: The market for GLP-1 weight-loss treatments is intensely competitive, with advertising and promotional access driving significant revenue growth for pharmaceutical firms.

impacts.name: Eli Lilly
impacts.why: Court decisions protecting product advertisements help maintain marketing efforts for key growth drugs.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk
impacts.why: Failing to block rival ads maintains competitive pressure in the weight-loss drug market.
